title: Dynamite Joe
description: A government agent uses his talent for explosives to protect a U.S. gold shipment from marauding Comancheros.

title: Secret of Captain O'Hara
description: A disreputable cavalryman gets the opportunity to clear his name when his commander's fiancée is attacked by Indians.

title: Apache Fury
description: A judge encounters a man he once wronged after an Apache attack forces him, his fiancée and their fellow stagecoach passengers to take refuge at a rest stop.

title: The Counterfeit Kid
description: Farmhand Jack must get help from a group of wild misfits and find treasure before the outlaw he's been impersonating finds him.

title: Yellow Hair and the Fortress of Gold
description: The Pecos Kid (Ken Roberson) and a blonde (Laurene Landon) race a Mexican colonel (Luis Lorento) and renegades to gold guarded by Indians.

title: The Last Killer
description: The landowner John Barrett's men kill Ramon's parents. While trying to get revenge, Ramon is wounded but saves the life of Rezza, an old, disillusioned killer.

title: If You Want to Live... Shoot!
description: A young cowboy flees town after shooting a man over a rigged poker game.

title: Return of Halleluja
description: The gunslinger Alleluja is employed by Ramirez, the general of the Mexican revolution, to retrieve a stolen Aztec Indian statue from the hands of two unsuspecting thieves. With this statue, Ramirez hopes to ensure the Aztec Indians' become his ally.

title: Quinto: Fighting Proud
description: The Blackie gang pulls off the perfect bank heist. It's unknown who took the money.

title: The Son of Zorro
description: In imperial Mexico, Don Ricardo Villaverde leads a double life as the masked Son of Zorro, defending the oppressed from the cruel Governor Leblanche. When rebels ambush a weapons convoy and kill Don Herrera, his daughter Conchita is saved by Zorro.

title: I Want Him Dead
description: After his sister is kidnapped and murdered, a gunslinger's plans for vengeance involve assassinating two generals to prolong the Civil War.

title: Scalps
description: In the aftermath of the Civil war, rogue Southern soldiers kidnap a woman and slaughter everyone in her village after her father refuses to sell her to them.

title: Hey Amigo! A Toast to Your Death
description: A team of bandits carries out a big heist in a Texan village and subsequently runs away to a hideout. However, it is only a matter of time before the bandits get hunted down.

title: Thunder at the Border
description: Winnetou and his friend defend a town from outlaws while Winnetou's sister falls for a gunman.

title: Night of the Serpent
description: The commander of a garrison joins other villagers in their nefarious scheme to rob an orphan of his inheritance.

title: Savage Pampas
description: Captain Martín is facing an increasing number of defections by his troops in the plains of Argentina -- it seems they are joining ranks with Native American warriors because they are offered women as a reward. With the help of Miguel Carreras, Taylor is able to bring in a group of women to prevent the loss of more soldiers. But, Padrón, the leader of the bandit group that bribes the soldiers onto his side, proves to be a worthy foe.

title: The Executioner of God
description: A former gunman turned priest seeks vengeance on three bandits who are masquerading as law-abiding citizens.

title: Pancho Tequila
description: Pancho Tequila is a famous actor known for his western films who goes to his hometown to rest following his doctor's recommendation. His neighbors think Pancho is a hero like in the movies, but in reality he is an alcoholic womanizer.

title: The Deadly Trackers
description: Sean Kilpatrick (Richard Harris), a pacifist border-town sheriff, has used some unconventional methods to keep order in his tiny Texas town. But Kilpatrick's belief system is rocked when the villainous Frank Brand (Rod Taylor) and his gang murder Kilpatrick's family following a bank robbery that goes wrong. An enraged Kilpatrick trails the gang into Mexico, where he partners with local police officer Gutierrez (Al Lettieri) to bring down Brand once and for all.

title: Dead Men Don't Count
description: Two gunmen have their sights set on a large bounty but get caught up in a local war for land caused by the impending arrival of the railroad.

title: Killer Adios
description: A young man goes back to his hometown ten years after killing the killer of his parents. Once there, he is asked to help the sheriff.

title: Reverend Colt
description: The people of Tucson see a very unusual priest arrive, and he's wearing a collar on his belt. Everyone is wary of it.

title: Adios, Gringo
description: Locals want to hang a rancher (Giuliano Gemma) for stealing his own cattle and shooting a bad guy in self-defense.

title: Pancho Villa
description: This mostly fictional account follows the trigger-happy Mexican revolutionary Pancho Villa (Telly Savalas) in his attempt to kill bitter nemesis Gen. Goyo and overthrow Mexico's government. The violent endeavor brings Villa north to New Mexico, where he battles a group of determined American soldiers led by the no-nonsense Col. Wilcox (Chuck Connors), and endures unanticipated mishaps and bad fortune, including a double-cross by his friend and partner, Scotty (Clint Walker).

title: Crazy Westerners
description: Hoping to rid the world of evil, a female gunslinger (Rita Pavone) steals gold and plans to destroy it.
